claims.statement: For uniform z in the full BLS12-381 target group GT and fixed standard Q0 in G2, recover P in G1 with e(P,Q0)=z under the pinned pairing convention, the deterministic baby-step/giant-step algorithm in proof.md succeeds with probability at least 1 using at most 2^128.494762 total target-group-operation equivalents, including preprocessing and verification. Peak memory is at most 2^137.643857 bytes; preprocessing is at most 2^127.006014 target-group-operation equivalents and is included in total work; nonuniform advice is at most 2^0 bytes and is included in memory. This is a classical cold attack with no uncharged advice, quantum steps or heuristic assumptions. The exponential memory is required. This is an analytic generic accounting control, not a claim of novelty or practical execution.

experiments.purpose: Exhaustively check BSGS scalar recovery on a small additive cyclic group. This does not establish production curve behavior, memory bounds, or operation costs.
